papers.title: Dimensional assessment of uniformly periodic porosity primitive TPMS lattices using additive manufacturing laser powder bed fusion technique
papers.first_author_affiliation: Additive Design and Manufacturing Systems Laboratory, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Ali Mulhi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Design and Manufacturing Systems Laboratory, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造TPMS点阵的结构尺寸精度，与用户方向中的多孔结构与应力屏蔽相关，但未涉及生物医学应用或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no mechanical or fatigue testing reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估LPBF制造均匀周期孔隙TPMS点阵的尺寸精度。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量与设计模型对比，分析点阵单元的尺寸偏差。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数对孔隙单元尺寸精度的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量与CAD模型对比验证尺寸精度。

summary_en.motivation: To assess the dimensional accuracy of uniformly periodic porous TPMS lattices fabricated by LPBF.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization of as-built dimensions compared to the computer-aided design (CAD) model.
summary_en.result: Identified deviations and relationships between porosity unit cell size and manufacturing accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement and comparison with nominal design.

papers.title: Effect of build orientation on dynamic compressive behaviour of Ti-6Al-4V alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology Chongqing Innovation Center, Chongqing 401120, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Jing Xie
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Explosion Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Pengwan Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Explosion Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V的构建取向对动态压缩性能的影响，但未涉及生物医用植入物所需的应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究构建取向对SLM Ti-6Al-4V动态压缩行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 不同取向SLM成形后进行动态压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 构建取向显著影响动态压缩强度与应变率敏感性
summary_zh.validation: 动态压缩力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of build orientation on the dynamic compressive behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were manufactured with different orientations relative to the build platform and subjected to dynamic compression tests.
summary_en.result: Build orientation significantly influences dynamic strength and strain-rate sensitivity, with vertically oriented samples showing higher flow stress.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through dynamic compression testing at various strain rates using a split Hopkinson pressure bar.

papers.title: Combining Planning, Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning to solve Industrial Robot Tasks
papers.abstract: One of today's goals for industrial robot systems is to allow fast and easy provisioning for new tasks. Skill-based systems that use planning and knowledge representation have long been one possible answer to this. However, especially with contact-rich robot tasks that need careful parameter settings, such reasoning techniques can fall short if the required knowledge not adequately modeled. We show an approach that provides a combination of task-level planning and reasoning with targeted learning of skill parameters for a task at hand. Starting from a task goal formulated in PDDL, the learnable parameters in the plan are identified and an operator can choose reward functions and parameters for the learning process. A tight integration with a knowledge framework allows to form a prior for learning and the usage of multi-objective Bayesian optimization eases to balance aspects such as safety and task performance that can often affect each other. We demonstrate the efficacy and versatility of our approach by learning skill parameters for two different contact-rich tasks and show their successful execution on a real 7-DOF KUKA-iiwa.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及机器人技能参数学习，与FEA代理建模或植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on robot task planning and reinforcement learning for industrial manipulation, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决接触式机器人任务中参数难以建模的问题
summary_zh.method: 结合PDDL任务规划与多目标贝叶斯优化学习技能参数
summary_zh.result: 在两种接触式任务上成功学习参数并执行
summary_zh.validation: 在真实KUKA机器人上验证任务执行

summary_en.motivation: To enable fast provisioning of industrial robot tasks by combining planning and learning for contact-rich tasks with unknown parameters.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach integrating PDDL-based task planning with multi-objective Bayesian optimization to learn skill parameters, using a knowledge framework to form a prior.
summary_en.result: The method successfully learned parameters for two contact-rich tasks and executed them on a real 7-DOF KUKA robot.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on a real robot platform for two different contact-rich tasks.

papers.title: Sequential Predictive Conformal Inference for Time Series
papers.abstract: We present a new distribution-free conformal prediction algorithm for sequential data (e.g., time series), called the \textit{sequential predictive conformal inference} (\texttt{SPCI}). We specifically account for the nature that time series data are non-exchangeable, and thus many existing conformal prediction algorithms are not applicable. The main idea is to adaptively re-estimate the conditional quantile of non-conformity scores (e.g., prediction residuals), upon exploiting the temporal dependence among them. More precisely, we cast the problem of conformal prediction interval as predicting the quantile of a future residual, given a user-specified point prediction algorithm. Theoretically, we establish asymptotic valid conditional coverage upon extending consistency analyses in quantile regression. Using simulation and real-data experiments, we demonstrate a significant reduction in interval width of \texttt{SPCI} compared to other existing methods under the desired empirical coverage.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注时间序列的共形预测，未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 时间序列数据非可交换，现有共形预测方法不适用。
summary_zh.method: 提出顺序预测共形推断，自适应重估计非一致性分数条件分位数。
summary_zh.result: 在期望覆盖下显著减小预测区间宽度。
summary_zh.validation: 仿真和真实数据实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Time series data are non-exchangeable, rendering many conformal prediction methods invalid.
summary_en.method: Proposes sequential predictive conformal inference that adaptively re-estimates conditional quantiles of non-conformity scores.
summary_en.result: Achieves significantly narrower prediction intervals under desired empirical coverage.
summary_en.validation: Validated via simulation and real-data experiments.

papers.title: General multi-fidelity surrogate models: Framework and active learning strategies for efficient rare event simulation
papers.abstract: Estimating the probability of failure for complex real-world systems using high-fidelity computational models is often prohibitively expensive, especially when the probability is small. Exploiting low-fidelity models can make this process more feasible, but merging information from multiple low-fidelity and high-fidelity models poses several challenges. This paper presents a robust multi-fidelity surrogate modeling strategy in which the multi-fidelity surrogate is assembled using an active learning strategy using an on-the-fly model adequacy assessment set within a subset simulation framework for efficient reliability analysis. The multi-fidelity surrogate is assembled by first applying a Gaussian process correction to each low-fidelity model and assigning a model probability based on the model's local predictive accuracy and cost. Three strategies are proposed to fuse these individual surrogates into an overall surrogate model based on model averaging and deterministic/stochastic model selection. The strategies also dictate which model evaluations are necessary. No assumptions are made about the relationships between low-fidelity models, while the high-fidelity model is assumed to be the most accurate and most computationally expensive model. Through two analytical and two numerical case studies, including a case study evaluating the failure probability of Tristructural isotropic-coated (TRISO) nuclear fuels, the algorithm is shown to be highly accurate while drastically reducing the number of high-fidelity model calls (and hence computational cost).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度代理模型和主动学习策略可用于生物力学植入物设计中的稀有事件（如失效概率）估计，但未涉及植入物或生物力学具体应用。
llm.why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no demonstration on structural mechanics or patient-specific design; no uncertainty quantification on surrogate predictions beyond failure probability.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真模型计算昂贵，难以估计小失效概率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于高斯过程校正和模型平均的多保真度代理模型，结合子集模拟和主动学习。
summary_zh.result: 在多个案例中大幅减少高保真模型调用次数，同时保持高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析和数值案例验证，包括TRISO核燃料失效概率评估。

summary_en.motivation: Estimating failure probabilities for complex systems using high-fidelity models is computationally prohibitive, especially for rare events.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity surrogate framework is developed using Gaussian process corrections for low-fidelity models, fused via model averaging or selection within an active learning subset simulation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy with drastically reduced high-fidelity model calls across analytical and numerical case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two analytical and two numerical examples, including a TRISO nuclear fuel failure probability case.
